title: List of sparks
description: A list of sparks, represented as a JSON array in sparks.json. Each spark is a typed question-and-answer pair. type is one of s, p, a, r, or k (lowercase). id is optional: 16 lowercase hex characters, the XXH64 of the spark that sparks add writes on insertion. Files without ids are valid. This schema does not describe the agent skill in SKILL.md.

spark.description: One spark: a typed question-and-answer pair with an optional id.
